_about: An example of a style profile: your look, laid over any theme. Copy to style/profile.json (git-ignored) and edit, or let `npm run style -- from <reel>` then `npm run style -- use <name>` write it. `prefs` are tastes learnt from your review notes (`npm run style -- learn "..."`); agents read prefs, notes and pace before writing a storyboard.
name: Example: clean dark
notes: colors: accent = the colour that pops, ink = the dark surface, paper = the light one.

prefs.note: fewer graphics: two per section at most
